title: 银甲白袍东方女武士
prompt:
Chinese animation (donghua) style CG portrait, semi-realistic fantasy character design, vertical 9:16 composition, medium shot framed from crown to mid-thigh, character centered filling approximately 85% of the frame, shot from a very slightly low angle.

An adult Eastern female warrior with porcelain fair skin featuring a glossy dewy sheen, large black eyes with long lashes, light makeup and soft under-eye blush, a small refined nose and glossy pink lips slightly parted. She stands in a three-quarter pose, her head tilted slightly down as she gazes at the viewer with calm, regal confidence.

Very long straight ink-black hair with straight bangs, a braided section at one side, and two long face-framing strands. A large ornate golden crown with pointed spikes and leaf-like filigree sits atop her head, and a large dark royal-blue satin bow rests behind one side of her head.

She wears a luxurious white satin fantasy gown-armor: a form-fitting bodice of glossy white satin and polished silver armor plates edged with gold trim and a V-shaped gold neckline, a wide fluffy white fur collar over her shoulders, royal-blue satin panels at the sides, gold braided cords crossing her chest with long gold tassels, a structured white-and-gold waist guard, and a layered white satin skirt with gold piping, royal-blue side panels, diamond-shaped side cutouts, white thigh bands with hanging gold diamond pendants, plus a silver greave on one leg.

Her armored black-and-silver gauntlet grips the blue hilt of a greatsword whose golden crossguard is carved with an intricate openwork pattern, the blade's edge leaving the frame at the lower left.

Tall and slender, well-proportioned figure, long limbs, elegant posture.

Foreground: the sword hilt and gauntlet at the left edge. Midground: the warrior herself, framed from crown to thighs. Background: a plain off-white wall with the soft shadow of her head and crown cast on the upper left. Composition places her face about one-fifth down the frame and slightly right of center, with the sword's diagonal leading the eye upward to her face.

Lighting is bright, soft and even from the front, with a gentle bloom halation on the satin and fur, a clean high-key grade with warm golden highlights and softly lifted shadows, background softly blurred, no haze, and a mood of majestic, elegant, cool regality.

Midjourney-grade micro-detail: individual hair strands, satin weave, gold filigree, fur fibers, soft luminous skin with a subtle dewy sheen, and fine 35mm film grain.

Color palette: ivory white #F5F2EA, royal blue #1E3A8A, antique gold #C9A227, silver #C0C0C0, ink black #1A1A1A, porcelain skin #F7DDD0.

No text, no watermark, no logo, no UI elements, no status bar, no player controls, no extra people, no extra fingers, no distorted armor, no duplicated crown.

Signature: "AI art gallery | @sandmrk" in small white Arial font at bottom center.
